newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares flat, Creative up in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares flat, Creative up in early trade.

text.p: Singapore shares nudged up at the open but quickly fell back flat on Monday while blue chips sustained gains from last week, brokers said.

Creative Technology started with a bang with its shares leaping over 10 percent but profit-taking soon trimmed its gains. At 0135 GMT, Creative was up Singapore $0.75 (US$0.53) to S$9.75, off the morning's high of S$10.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index dipped 0.16 point to 2,068.01 after 35 minutes. Volume was a slim 15.7 million shares with 35 rises, 28 losses and 53 counters unchanged.
"While some funds have switched out of Singapore, others are buying blue chips. These blue chips have fundamental support," said an institutional dealer.

Singapore Press Holdings (SPH) foreign, which was sold down last week ahead of its full-year results, was still weak. It was down S$0.60 to S$23. SPH reported its net profit had dipped 1.1 percent to S$307.63 million.
Ho Wah Genting led actives with 1.2 million shares but eased S$0.26 to S$1.10. Last week, it was boosted by speculative buying.
